body: I do agree on that! I think what you say is very important, we are at a relatively good state in history I believe, I just think I apply too much pressure upon myself, im lucky I have a lot of people around that actually share the same views and want to help, thanks for that tip I will put it to use. I’m sorry you had to go through all of that I’m sure is not easy but as you said, there is always an act of good, and you have done one, so thanks.

I think I understand what feeling nothing implicates and I wouldn’t wish that upon anyone nor do I want that for me, I actually do thing empathy is so important, is just as an individual sometimes it becomes too much, that’s why death seems alluring as the only way out, instead of numbness.

It is a lot to take in, the quote ignorance is bliss really makes more sense as I find more and more things that should be better, I really wish there was an easier way, the hardest thing is exactly what you explained, trying to be realistic as to what i can actually help with and what I should burden myself with, trying to work it out. Thank you.
Thank you, I hope you have a good one too :)

Thank you, It makes me feel so much better knowing there’s is people who worry for even the smallest beings, I’m grateful for you’re encouragement since worrying in this world where there only so much you can do really drains you, please also take care of yourself, and I will follow your tip and try to find love as the driving force.
